data.name: Dispelling Master
data.description: You can spontaneously convert any prepared spell into dispel magic or greater dispel magic as a cleric converts prepared spells into cure spells.|PRESPELLCAST:MEMORIZE=Y

raw_tokens.value: You can spontaneously convert any prepared spell into dispel magic or greater dispel magic as a cleric converts prepared spells into cure spells.|PRESPELLCAST:MEMORIZE=Y
You add dispel magic and greater dispel magic to your spells known.|PRESPELLCAST:MEMORIZE=N
Every time you successfully use either of these spells to make a targeted dispel or counterspell, you heal hit points equal to the caster level of the effect dispelled or counterspelled.
